title: themelium yoderi
intro: Themelium yoderi, commonly known as the Yoder's polypody, is a species of fern in the family Hymenophyllaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its ability to provide relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Themelium yoderi include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in reducing stress, improving respiratory health, and boosting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds that contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as analgesic, antispasmodic, and anti-allergic properties.
